title: Zion, the City of Our God

questions.question: Great is the Lord and greatly to be praised in the city of our what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 48:1 (ESV): "Great is the Lord and greatly to be praised in the city of our God,"

questions.question: His holy mountain, beautiful in elevation, is the joy of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 48:2 (ESV): "beautiful in elevation, is the joy of all the earth,"

questions.question: Mount Zion, in the far north, the city of the great what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 48:2 (ESV): "Mount Zion, in the far north, the city of the great King."

questions.question: Within her citadels God has made himself known as a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 48:3 (ESV): "Within her citadels God has made himself known as a fortress."

questions.question: For behold, the kings assembled; they came on how?
questions.explanation: Psalm 48:4 (ESV): "For behold, the kings assembled; they came on together."

questions.question: As soon as they saw it, they were astounded; they were in panic; they took to what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 48:5 (ESV): "...they were in panic; they took to flight."

questions.question: Trembling took hold of them there, anguish as of a woman in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 48:6 (ESV): "Trembling took hold of them there, anguish as of a woman in labor."

questions.question: By the east wind you shattered the ships of where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 48:7 (ESV): "By the east wind you shattered the ships of Tarshish."

questions.question: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the Lord of hosts, in the city of our God, which God will establish when?
We have thought on your steadfast love, O God, in the midst of your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 48:9 (ESV): "We have thought on your steadfast love, O God, in the midst of your temple."

questions.question: As your name, O God, so your praise reaches to the ends of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 48:10 (ESV): "As your name, O God, so your praise reaches to the ends of the earth."

questions.question: Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 48:11 (ESV): "...Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments!"

questions.question: Walk about Zion, go around her, number her what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 48:12 (ESV): "Walk about Zion, go around her, number her towers,"

questions.question: Consider well her ramparts, go through her citadels, that you may tell the next what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 48:13 (ESV): "...that you may tell the next generation"

questions.question: That this is God, our God forever and ever. He will guide us when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 48:14 (ESV): "...He will guide us forevermore." (Or to the end)

key_verse_text: Great is the Lord and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, his holy mountain.
